messages:
noah: hey team — day 2 here. trying to switch into the org role for the eu account to link a customer sandbox and getting 403 when I hit the console. can't access eu-west-1 resources. who do I ping for permissions?

onboard-bot: Welcome Noah! If you need account/billing access please post here and tag @irene or @finance. See: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/cloud-access

irene: hey @noah — can you paste the exact error or a screenshot? is this when using the AWS console switch-role, or when calling via CLI?

noah: console switch-role -> I paste the account/role and get a 403 page. also tried `aws sts assume-role` and got `AccessDenied`

noah: error snippet: ```
An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the AssumeRole operation: User: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:user/noah is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::222222222222:role/OrgRole
```

ben: quick guess — our org SCP for some EU accounts denies cross-account assume for certain principals. sometimes the payer account also locks billing console. pinging @sam to confirm. can you also run `aws sts get-caller-identity` and paste output?

sam: yup — billing access is separate from account role. to see invoices you need permissions on the payer/billing account or be added to the Billing console role. I'll need the target payer account id and the ticket to add you (we require justification).

noah: caller id: ```{
  "UserId": "AID...NOAH",
  "Account": "111111111111",
  "Arn": "arn:aws:iam::111111111111:user/noah"
}```

irene: thanks. @noah, two paths: (1) short-term: do dev work in us-east-1 or a non-eu sandbox where your role is already allowed, (2) longer-term: finance needs to add you to the billing account and infra needs to adjust the SCP or add an explicit allow for the org role you use.

ben: workaround commands if you want to test cross-account assume via CLI (replace IDs):
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::222222222222:role/OrgRole --role-session-name noah-test
```
If that fails with AccessDenied it's org-level. We can also check org policies: `aws organizations list-policies --filter SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY`

noah: ok I'll open a ticket. where should I create it?

irene: open INFRA access ticket at https://redwood.atlassian.net/ with component=cloud-access + tag `billing` and mention @sam and @ben. include the caller id above and the payer account id (ask your AE if you don't have it).

noah: filed INFRA-1189 and tagged @sam @ben — added screenshot of 403 and the caller id.

finance-bot: INFRA-1189 created and assigned to `finance` queue. ETA 2 business days for manual billing invites (if no policy blockers).

sam: got it — I'll review the payer and escalate if org SCP blocking is unexpected. in the meantime you can work in us-east-1. if you need a temporary console session we can generate a short-lived role session and DM credentials (will follow least-privilege).

noah: perfect, thanks all. will use us-east for now and wait on INFRA-1189. appreciate the fast responses :thumbsup:
